title: English Practice Quiz 0933
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A successful negotiation aims to reach ___.
options: an acceptable agreement between the parties
a result that ignores every concern
questions.explanation: Negotiation involves discussion to reach an agreement.

questions.question: Before negotiating, it is useful to identify your ___.
questions.explanation: Knowing priorities helps you evaluate possible agreements.

questions.question: A 'win-win' outcome is one in which ___.
questions.explanation: A win-win outcome provides benefits to both sides.

questions.question: During a negotiation, asking open questions can help you ___.
A concession in negotiation is ___.
options: something a party agrees to give up or adjust
a final legal judgement in every case
questions.explanation: A concession is an adjustment made to help reach agreement.

questions.question: If an offer is unclear, you should ___.
options: ask for the terms to be explained

questions.question: A negotiation deadline is ___.
options: the time by which an agreement or decision is expected
the start of a lunch break
the date a person was hired
questions.explanation: A deadline sets a time limit for the negotiation.

questions.question: Remaining calm during a difficult negotiation helps you ___.
options: guarantee that the other side agrees

questions.question: A written agreement should record ___.
options: the terms accepted by the parties
private details unrelated to the deal
questions.explanation: Written terms provide a clear record of what was agreed.

questions.question: If no agreement is possible, the parties may ___.
options: consider another option or pause the discussion
questions.explanation: A pause or alternative process may be appropriate when positions remain far apart.
